title: Hurley Men's One & Only Boardshort 22" Team Red (34)

comparisons.notes: Same Hurley One & Only Boardshort 22" (style MBS0002130, 6pm SKU 8293069) in the exact Team Red/Burgundy Ash colorway at $28.
Same style, product 8293069, at $36 with Team Red/Burgundy Ash offered as a color option.

writeup: Hurley's One & Only 22-inch boardshort in Team Red, men's size 34, is $6.99 new on Woot. 6pm sells this exact colorway for $28 and Zappos lists the style at $36, so Woot is about 75% under the cheapest store. Quick-dry polyester, tie-close fly and a flap cargo pocket. Only one was left at last check.
